name: Sea Island Resort
positioning: Georgia coast resort whose lodgings include The Cloister, on 50 acres between the river, salt marshes and the sea with five miles of private beach, and The Lodge, set beside championship golf
best_for: Beach lovers who want a private stretch of Atlantic coastline
Golfers who want three championship courses and a golf performance center
Travelers who enjoy outdoor experiences such as beach horseback rides and a hawk walk

facts.text: The Cloister is set on 50 acres surrounded by the river, saltwater marshes and the sea.
Beach Club rooms at The Cloister have Spanish Mediterranean decor with Oriental rugs and exposed beam ceilings, and many have ocean views.
The Sea Island Beach Club has three swimming pools and water sports.
The Cloister Ocean Residences sit in a private, gated enclave with their own oceanfront infinity pool.
Rooms in The Cloister's Garden Wing are reached along outdoor corridors past koi ponds and gardens.
The Fitness Center has an indoor heated lap pool, squash courts, steam and sauna, whirlpool and cryotherapy.
The Lodge sits right next door to championship golf.
The Plantation and Seaside courses are home to the PGA TOUR's RSM Classic.
The Seaside Course is a Scottish links-style course surrounded by tidal creeks, dunes, salt marshes and the Atlantic Ocean.
A walking tour of The Cloister covers its history along with art, architecture and antiquities unique to the hotel.
Guests can take out a complimentary BMW during their stay, first come, first served, for up to two hours.
Southern Tide at the Beach Club is an al fresco oceanfront restaurant.

highlights.text: The Sea Island Beach Club and a five-mile stretch of private beach are right across the street from The Cloister Main Building.
Sea Island has three championship golf courses and a 17,000-square-foot Golf Performance Center.
The Spa at Sea Island is inspired by water, with hydrotherapy, foot reflexology paths and mineral soaking tubs.
Guests can take horseback rides along the south end of Sea Island beach.
The Lodge offers 24-hour personal butler service.

considerations.text: The Lodge is a few minutes' drive from Sea Island and The Cloister, so the two lodgings are not side by side.
Golf events held at Sea Island throughout the year limit play on the courses.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
